item.text:
**4B.5 Research Note**

Bottom line: I found strong 2024 evidence that Khamenei did **not** avoid personality-based rule, loyalty policing, or politicization of supposedly neutral institutions. The strongest material is about election vetting, coercive discipline of critics, and the use of police, judiciary, and media-linked institutions to enforce conformity. I found **no reliable affirmative 2024 evidence** that he deliberately avoided these practices.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Iran’s presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters said Khamenei “ensured” hardline candidates dominated the contest and that the Guardian Council, aligned to him, approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants. The article also quoted an adviser saying voters should choose a president whose views do not conflict with the supreme leader. This is direct evidence of loyalty filtering and politicization of the electoral arena. | 4B.5, 4B.1, 4B.2 |
| Iran bans ex-president Rouhani from running for elite assembly | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-01-24 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-bans-ex-president-rouhani-from-running-for-elite-assembly/1937211/ | The Guardian Council blocked Hassan Rouhani from the Assembly of Experts, the body that can monitor and dismiss the supreme leader. That is evidence that a nominal oversight institution was kept under loyalty control rather than insulated from Khamenei’s influence. | 4B.5, 4B.4, 4B.2 |
| Iran: Chokehold on Dissent | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent | HRW described violent repression of peaceful dissent, detention of critics and victims’ families, and retaliation against students, journalists, artists, and activists. This is strong evidence of intimidation and of state institutions being used against critics rather than neutrally. | 4B.5, 4B.3, 4B.10 |
| Iran: authorities unleash heavily militarized clampdown to hide protest massacres | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/ | Amnesty said multiple state bodies, including police, prosecutors, courts, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij, participated in a surveillance-and-punishment campaign against women defying hijab rules. This is direct evidence of institutional politicization and intimidation, not neutrality. | 4B.5, 4B.3, 4B.10 |
| Iran: new compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/ | Amnesty reported the judiciary drafted the law, the Guardian Council approved it, and parliament implemented it, while the law expanded enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij. This is strong evidence that nominally neutral institutions were mobilized for coercive ideological enforcement. | 4B.5, 4B.2, 4B.3 |

**Search gap**
- I found no solid 2024 source showing Khamenei deliberately avoided personality cult behavior, loyalty tests, or politicization of neutral state institutions.
- The only thin counter-signal was that Reuters noted he did **not publicly back any candidate** in the 2024 presidential race, but the same Reuters coverage still described a tightly controlled contest dominated by hardline loyalists. That is not credible evidence of restraint.
